build.method: disjoint worker processes (worker.py: a stable sha256 partition of (provider, match_id)) write one generation per dataset with atomic shard writes; one plain pass of scripts.materialize_tc3_frames then writes the rest and the dataset manifest. manifest_all.json n_attempted counts only that last pass.

meaning: run_commit = the library at measurement time; the stage provenance of each dataset is under datasets
